description: Every pinned version gets an update PR; nothing reaches the cluster until a maintainer merges and tags a release. When an update also needs a SHA-256, a vendored file or a re-measurement, CI fails until that is done: the red check is the work order (docs/runbooks/dependency-updates.md).

customManagers.description: Helm chart external-secrets: pinned again in ci/versions.env next to its SHA-256 (same PR as its Argo CD Application)
Helm chart alloy: pinned again in ci/versions.env next to its SHA-256 (same PR as its Argo CD Application)
Helm chart kube-state-metrics: pinned again in ci/versions.env next to its SHA-256 (same PR as its Argo CD Application)
Helm chart kyverno: pinned again in ci/versions.env next to its SHA-256 (same PR as its Argo CD Application)
Argo CD release: CRD URLs in ci/versions.env (the install manifest is vendored by hand, SHA-256 checked)
Kyverno CLI that tests gitops/policies offline
Container images pinned by tag and digest in ci/versions.env
Shared CI tool pins: tag and the commit it must resolve to
EKS AL2023 AMI release in the Karpenter EC2NodeClasses (the managed node group release_version in modules/eks/main.tf moves with it)

packageRules.description: This repo's own release tags move with the release PR, not with Renovate
Charts: the Argo CD Application and ci/versions.env share the dependency name, so they land in one PR
prBodyNotes: Update the chart SHA-256 in `ci/versions.env` (`helm pull` then `sha256sum`); `validate` fails until it matches.

packageRules.description: Karpenter: the CloudFormation file in ci/karpenter/ is vendored per version
prBodyNotes: Re-vendor `ci/karpenter/cloudformation-<version>.yaml` and its SHA-256 in `ci/validate.sh`, then `python3 -I ci/karpenter/extract.py ... --check`.

packageRules.description: Argo CD: re-vendor the install manifest and read the upgrade notes
prBodyNotes: Re-vendor `gitops/argocd/upstream/install-<version>.yaml`, update `ARGOCD_*_SHA256` and the kustomization; read https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/operator-manual/upgrading/overview/ .

packageRules.description: vLLM: a new engine version invalidates latency numbers; re-measure before citing them
prBodyNotes: Every latency number in README, evidence and CV states the vLLM version it was measured on: re-run the operator's first-request job and say which numbers still hold.

packageRules.description: AMI: weekly releases; monthly is enough outside security fixes
prBodyNotes: Set `release_version` in `modules/eks/main.tf` to the same release (`aws ssm get-parameter --name /aws/service/eks/optimized-ami/1.36/amazon-linux-2023/x86_64/standard/recommended/release_version`).

packageRules.description: Majors wait for an explicit go on the dependency dashboard
